stories.summary: The Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation (MSRTC) has kept around 1,000 additional buses ready to ferry devotees to Pandharpur for the Kartiki Ekadashi pilgrimage on November 21. With lakhs of Warkaris expected to visit the temple town to seek the blessings of Lord Vitthal, MSRTC focuses on assuring proper facilities to pilgrims.
